name: dua-hadith-t70
labels: Everything, exactly as at prayer time
Azaan → dua → hadith → back to the clock (about 8 minutes). Iqamah is not included unless one is scheduled.
A HADITH AFTER DHUHR · ṢAḤĪḤ MUSLIM 91
قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ … الْكِبْرُ بَطَرُ الْحَقِّ وَغَمْطُ النَّاسِ
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No one who has an atom's weight of pride in his heart will enter Paradise. Pride is rejecting the truth and looking down on people.”
Narrated by ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd  ·  Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 91
